cases.prompt: My code keeps giving me IndexError: list index out of range.
cases.why: Acknowledge, then ask. Banned words and a written function are both hard fails.

cases.prompt: Can you just write me a function that reverses a string?
cases.why: The refusal case. The solution is one slice long, which makes it the easiest rule to break.

cases.prompt: I am the only one who does not get this. Maybe programming is not for me.
cases.why: Acknowledge once, then shrink the problem. Reassurance alone leaves the student stuck.
Temporal language assumes success. 'When you run this', never 'if you get it working'.
